label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
**Subject:** Re: Nia's hen

Hi Beth,

Replying just to you, not the group one.

I'm not here to give you a row, honestly. I know Lowri's 40th was grim and you both said things, and I'm staying out of who said what. But I reckon Lowri's sorrier than she's letting on. She's just as stubborn as you are, and I say that with love.

Would you think about coming for the Saturday only? You'd only need to be in Tenby for 6. The train from Cardiff Central is about two and a half hours and I'll pick you up from the station. Skip the cottage on the Friday if that's easier. I've got the twin room, so you can stay with me Saturday night and you won't be on your own in it.

I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work to get the weekend off, and I really wanted that night stop. So it matters to me that we're all there.

Nia rang me last week in tears asking if you were still coming. She doesn't know you've pulled out yet. I keep thinking about you sitting with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019. She hasn't forgotten that, and you've got your reading at Margam on the 17th April too. I just don't want you looking back and wishing you'd been there.

One favour, hang on before you send Lowri the £85. Give it a few days.

Ring me if you want to talk it through. Even if the answer's still no, I'd rather you heard all this from me.

Siân x

reasons: It does not explicitly invite Bethan to Saturday’s meal or convey that Nia will remember her absence.
